text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae apologized to her Trainer, 
worried that she had been too harsh with 
Copano Rickey during the Champions Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following her clash with Hokko Tarumae, 
Copano Rickey was left wondering whether 
making everyone happy through Feng Shui 
was simply an impossible dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to just stand by, Smart Falcon 
creates and performs a special cheer song 
to encourage Copano Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by the song, Copano Rickey was 
able to return to her roots once more.
